source='''def transform(grid):
    # A solid horizontal row separates a pattern from the pattern to filter.
    sep = next(i for i, row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row)) == 1 and i > 0 and i < len(grid) - 1)
    top = grid[:sep]
    bottom = grid[sep + 1:]
    if len(top) != len(bottom):
        raise ValueError("pattern bands must have equal heights")
    return [[2 if top[r][c] != 0 and bottom[r][c] != 0 else 0
             for c in range(len(bottom[r]))] for r in range(len(bottom))]
'''
